fato_historico: 2019: Ukrainian filmmaker Oleg Sentsov and 66 others are released in a prisoner exchange between Ukraine and Russia.
energia_do_dia: Today carries a beautiful energy of liberation and healing. Much like the quiet strength found in releasing heavy burdens, you may find that letting go of old worries allows your spirit to soar. It is a good time to clear your workspace and your mind, making room for new growth and unexpected, lucky opportunities to blossom in your daily routine.
frase_do_dia: True freedom begins when we release the weight we no longer need to carry.
significado_numero: Represents the grace of finding unexpected hope amidst challenging circumstances.
conselho: Consider letting go of a minor perfectionist habit to invite more joy today.
